answer: Home pickup isn't available in Texas, so you'd need to book an appraisal appointment at a store instead. For a leased car, first check that your leasing company allows third-party buyouts, then get a dealer payoff quote from them (or sign form NW-LSE-1 and we'll request it for you), and bring that quote to your appointment. Also bring a physical photo ID for every owner on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, the title if you have it, and the odometer disclosure statement, form NW-ODO-2. Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
